If the host raises the first SizeChanged before that store (the real runtime does so after layout, normally later), the process crashes at 0x58718. Host must delay the first SizeChanged until [AppMain+0x34]->+0xC != 0 (or until the job started). The first SizeChanged also calls setSize(0,0) (platform scale +0x3C/+0x40 still zero) -> 240x140 clamp, harmless because rendering has not started.

The host timer should start ticking only after the first SizeChanged.
